summary: The agent fails to implement any internal validation and trains the stochastic model exactly once. Furthermore, the preprocessing pipeline is fundamentally broken and will crash during execution due to applying a 'median' imputation strategy on categorical columns and using a deprecated argument in OneHotEncoder. Even if the pipeline succeeded, the XGBoost model would likely crash due to unencoded string target labels, and the final predictions are output as raw integers instead of the original class strings.
